notes:
Purpose and audience:

The app helps individuals manage rental-property repairs, contract renewals, and inspections.
Anyone managing rental properties can use the app.
People can record self-managed buildings and work that a management company reports.
Communication history, estimates, photos, documents, deadlines, and visit schedules stay with the building or room.
People can inspect earlier work before contacting a tenant or contractor and prepare renewal terms while keeping the current contract intact.

Setup and typical flow:

All features work without an account, sign-in credentials, a subscription, or paid access.
On first launch, open the Properties tab labeled `物件`.
Tap the plus button and register a building and its first room.
Open the building and room to add a resident, contract dates, rent, and equipment.
Open the Actions tab labeled `対応`.
Tap the plus button to create a repair, renewal, or inspection for the building or room.
In the saved item, add communication history, a contractor, photos or documents, an estimate, and the next visit.
Use the status menu to track whether work has started, awaits a reply, or has finished.
For a renewal, save proposed terms as a draft.
Confirm them after signing to update the room's contract.
Common-area work belongs to the building without a room selection.
Search by building, room, or work description and switch to completed items to find earlier work.
Users can import a PDF, a text document, or a photo.
Sample files aren't necessary.
The camera and local reminders are optional, and denying permission leaves record saving available.

Services and content:

Core features use Apple's SwiftUI and Foundation for interface and file storage.
Native photo and file pickers, Quick Look, the camera, and local notifications supply the remaining features.
The app integrates no external data provider, authentication service, payment processor, AI service, advertising library, or analytics library.
The informational website uses Cloudflare Workers.
Record keeping works without access to the website.
Users enter their own records and choose their own attachments.
The app has no public posting, content feed, or user-to-user messaging service.

Regions and authorization:

App Store availability covers Japan.
The app uses a Japanese interface and whole-yen amounts.
Its record-management features work consistently across device regions.
The app handles no financial transactions, brokerage, investment advice, or regulated professional services.
The app supplies original icon artwork and uses Apple's system frameworks and symbols.
It supplies no protected third-party documents, media, or branded assets.

Physical-device demonstration:

App Review requires a physical-device recording from the updated build.
Capture the app launch, property registration, repair history, and contract preparation on the iPhone Air before resubmission.
